_note: A warning is an absent field (normal — a script stubs what its page reads) or a field core does not send (usually drift). Values that are actually wrong — null in a non-nullable field, a wrong type, an impossible enum value — fail outright and are never counted here.
_rule: The number may FALL, never rise. If a run reports fewer, lower the entry in the same commit — that is how ground gained is kept. If it reports more, a fixture has drifted from doc/core/api-shapes.json: fix the fixture rather than raising the number, unless the change is deliberate and the commit says why.
_: Contract warnings each browser spec is currently allowed. Generated 2026-08-15; see tests/support/contract.mjs.
